title: The Public Lands Hating Trump Administration is Going After the Roadless Rule
content:
The Public Lands-hating Trump Administration’s USDA has announced its plan to rescind Roadless Rule protections on 45 million acres of National Forests. 45 MILLION ACRES! Roadless areas are where Americans hike, climb, bike, paddle, ski, hunt, and explore — and rolling back the Rule would allow new roads and large-scale logging in some of our most wild backcountry areas. We know you’re all fatigued from the constant and persistent attacks on our Public Land, but we need to hammer our elected officials hard over this.

We have until September 20th to submit public comments. But don’t delay!

Outdoor Alliance has a simple and easy form to use. You can use the org’s boilerplate email form or write your own, but it’s essential that we call on Congress to protect our wild lands!

Check it out at Outdoor Alliance.
